name: GitHub CLI
description: Installs GitHub CLI (gh) with optional GitHub Copilot CLI and skills support

installGitKraken.description: Install GitKraken CLI (gk) for enhanced git operations. Requires git feature to be installed.

skills.description: Comma-separated list of Copilot skills to install (e.g., 'tf-module,api-design'). Skills are always downloaded when specified, regardless of authentication status.
